mapper.select: SELECT ae.id, ae.event_no, ae.source_device_id, ae.water_area_id, ae.confidence, ae.alert_type, ae.status, ae.snapshot_url, ae.video_clip_url, ae.confirmed_by, ae.confirmed_at, ae.false_alarm_reason, ae.resolved_at, ae.created_at, ae.updated_at, ae.deleted, ae.alert_location, d.device_name AS source_device_name, w.name AS water_area_name, u.real_name AS confirmed_by_name FROM alert_event ae LEFT JOIN device d ON ae.source_device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN water_area w ON ae.water_area_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ae.confirmed_by = u.id WHERE ae.id = #{id} AND ae.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_event ( event_no, source_device_id, water_area_id, alert_location, confidence, alert_type, status, snapshot_url, video_clip_url, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, false_alarm_reason, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{event.eventNo}, #{event.sourceDeviceId}, #{event.waterAreaId}, #{event.alertLocation}, #{event.confidence}, COALESCE(#{event.alertType}, 'DROWNING'), COALESCE(#{event.status}, 'PENDING'), #{event.snapshotUrl}, #{event.videoClipUrl}, #{event.confirmedBy}, #{event.confirmedAt}, #{event.falseAlarmReason}, #{event.resolvedAt}, COALESCE(#{event.createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{event.updatedAt}, NOW()), 0 )
